definitions.explanation: How much something has grown, expressed as a percentage of its earlier size. Used of sales, users, wages, and populations, and generally positive in tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伸|の}び{率|りつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The growth rate of sales is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伸|の}び{率|りつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}った→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧。
examples.english: This year's growth rate came in below last year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伸|の}び{率|りつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}って→鈍る：14469_niburu⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The growth rate in the number of users has slowed, so new measures are needed.

notes:
⟦{伸|の}び→伸び：19827_nobi⟧ (growth, extension) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio). More everyday and more positive in tone than ⟦{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}→上昇率：30143_joushouritsu⟧, and common in business talk as well as news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伸|の}び{率|りつ}: the growth rate of sales
- {伸|の}び{率|りつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}る→鈍る：14469_niburu⟧: for the growth rate to slow
- ⟦{二桁|ふたけた}→二桁：15881_futaketa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伸|の}び{率|りつ}: a double-digit growth rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}→上昇率：30143_joushouritsu⟧: rate of increase — more technical, used of prices and indexes
- ⟦{成長率|せいちょうりつ}→成長率：30165_seichouritsu⟧: growth rate — the formal term for economies and companies
